_howToUse: Copy to ops/production-launch-evidence.json (git-ignored) and fill it in. EVERY boolean starts false and every attested field starts REPLACE ON PURPOSE: this file is a record of what a human OBSERVED, and a template that ships pre-attested values turns the launch gate into a rubber stamp. Flip a boolean to true only after you have personally checked that specific thing in the specific console or run that proves it. If you cannot check something, leave it false and let the verifier fail on it — a failing gate you understand is worth more than a passing gate built on values nobody verified.
reviewedBy: REPLACE — name of the person signing off on launch
reviewedAt: REPLACE — ISO date of sign-off, e.g. 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z

backups.lastSuccessfulBackupAt: REPLACE — ISO date of most recent automated backup
backups.restoreTestedAt: REPLACE — ISO date of the most recent completed restore drill (docs/BACKUP.md)
backups.deletionLedgerReconciledAt: REPLACE — ISO date of the most recent zero-blocker quarantined ledger reconciliation

monitoring.pagerEscalation: REPLACE — the actual on-call/escalation path for a production incident

webhookEvents: REPLACE — list the events actually enabled on the Stripe webhook endpoint, read from the Stripe dashboard. Do not copy this list from the events the code happens to handle.
stripe.lastWebhookTestAt: REPLACE — ISO date you last sent a test event from the Stripe dashboard

legalCompliance.reviewedAt: REPLACE — ISO date of legal/compliance review
legalCompliance.baaStatus: REPLACE — "signed" or "not_required"; not_required is the consumer-education posture, change it if GeneMap is offered to a covered entity
